title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization History Share in Good-Standing Coverage
content:
**Terms.** The next-period coverage collected with a good-standing payment on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries an AutoPay-history share, counted in whole calendar months from the enrollment date of the agreement's active Bluegate AutoPay Authorization to the handling date:

- **12 months or more** takes **80 percent**;
- **6 to 11 months** takes **90 percent**;
- a shorter or missing authorization takes the whole amount.

The share multiplies the coverage before it is rounded to the cent, half up, once. The enrollment date is read from the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization record in active status drafting this rental agreement; an agreement with no authorization in active status has a missing authorization.

## Ladder with edges (hypothetical enrollment on 10 January 2026)

| Handling date | Whole months enrolled | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 9 July 2026 | 5 | whole amount |
| 10 July 2026 | 6 | 90% |
| 9 January 2027 | 11 | 90% |
| 10 January 2027 | 12 | 80% |

## Basis question
*An authorization suspended after three years of drafting?* It is not in active status, so there is no active authorization to count from and the coverage is taken whole.
